high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Wired.com, viewed on a mobile device. The time displayed at the top of the screen is 7:57, and the device is connected to a 5G network with a partially charged battery. The article discusses an archive exhibit containing eight emails that were sent by Steve Jobs to himself. There is a gap between early May and June, during which Jobs was preparing for his opening keynote at the Apple Worldwide Developers Conference on June 6.
